blocks.text: PHILADELPHIA — Jayson Tatum dapped up Jaylen Brown with a friendly tap on the shoulder and thump on the chest which his former Boston teammate ignored. Brown gave him a cold shoulder. Tatum got the hot hand. Brown ignored Tatum’s brief show of affection, perhaps a fitting illustration of a frosty relationship that has included radio silence between the two All-Stars since Brown was traded in the summer to the Sixers.
